notes: SVG reconstruction, not pixel-identical raster extraction.
Texts exist only in layout.json and assembly previews, never baked into delivered sprites.
Backgrounds fixed at 1920x1080; UI sprite PNGs 2x SVG logical dimensions. Original character copied at native dimensions.
No pagination; list uses vertical scroll on overflow. No voice controls; text line navigation only.
Every affection level grants the corresponding record. Additional unlocks shown are layout samples, bind actual game data.
__portrait__ entries are external runtime layers and preview-only source crops, not delivered frame sprites.
Empty_Plus and Unlock_Lock are centered overlay sprites, separate from their 9-sliced frames to prevent symbol distortion.
Preview card art uses a tinted Skill_Icon placeholder; replace with real card artwork at runtime.
